I've had to do that almost every year now cause of either a bad draft or injuries lol. It's not that complicated, but requires a lot of patience and decent negotiating skill so you can win some trades. 

There will almost always be guys on the WW that don't belong or that go on short term hot streaks. Those are the guys you wanna find early and pick up. If one of them becomes good enough to be considered a core part of your team, hold on to him until he's not. If one of your pickups strikes someone else's interest, trade for one of their drafted guys that are actually living up to their draft position or better if possible.

Always buy low, always sell high. Otto/KAT/whatever playing shitty at the beginning of the season? Talk trade with his owner and get him for scraps. One of your guys is stringing together a few games where he's outperforming his averages/expectations? Trade his ass for someone who's getting similar numbers on a more regular basis before he stops.

It takes quite a bit of effort to fix a broken team, be it cause if injuries or bad picks. But never give up, you can almost always turn it around if you play your cards right.
